detailed_description: Text Summarizer creates an extractive summary in the browser. Paste text, choose Short, Medium, or Long, and the tool selects representative sentences based on word frequency, sentence position, and sentence length. It is useful for reducing notes, drafts, articles, or long messages before you review them manually. The page works with pasted text and does not generate rewritten paragraphs or process uploaded documents.
usage_steps: Paste the text into the main input area.
Choose Short, Medium, or Long for the summary length.
Review the original word count, summary word count, sentence count, and reduction percentage.
Read the generated summary and adjust the length if important context is missing.
Use Copy to move the result into your document, note, or editor.
usage_examples: Reduce meeting notes to their most representative sentences before sharing them.
Create a quick brief from a long draft before rewriting it.
Extract the central points from a product description or support message.
Turn a long email into a shorter review note without leaving the browser.
